text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P0 - runtime: container restart spike on gpu-pool-3 (prefill OOMs) - paging oncall

Maria: paging @oncall - saw a burst of container restarts on gpu-pool-3 starting ~10:02 UTC, prefills failing with OOM, customer-facing errors for /v1/generate. Impacting 2 customers (alpha-app, telemetry-q).

Jamie: oncall here, looking. any ETA on cause?

Sara: seeing CUDA OOM in runtime logs repeatedly for model rdx-large-v2 during prefill. counts: container restarts ~85 in last 6m.

Lee: markers: long prompt lengths > 120k tokens? that seems off. actual incoming context-lengths show 60k-80k tokens, but our prefill kv growth + quantized kernel triggers OOM.

Maria: curious — these requests are from alpha-app batch job? @CS-Ops can you confirm?

CS-Ops: confirmed. Alpha-app had an internal migration and started sending large system prompts to test embedding+generation. They rolled out at 09:58 UTC. We flagged them and are pausing their traffic now.

Jamie: good call. mitigation plan: 1) temporarily block very large prefill requests at the gateway (reject > 32k tokens), 2) set affected deployment to single-threaded CPU-prefill fallback, 3) restart node with drained pods to recover. executing steps now.

Sara: I pushed a temporary rate-limit rule to the gateway:

```
# envoy config snippet
- name: max_prefill_tokens
  value: "32000"
```

applied via config push.

Lee: adding runtime fix: disable prefill caching for rdx-large-v2 to avoid KV over-allocation. patch:

```
PATCH /api/v1/models/rdx-large-v2/config
{ "prefill": { "cache_enabled": false, "max_prefill_tokens": 32000 } }
```

rolling this now to dedicated nodes only.

Maria: logs showing typical trace:

```
2026-03-15T10:03:12Z runtime ERROR: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY during prefill kv_allocate
stack: at runtime/kernel/quantized.cu:512
container restart count=19
```

Also some pods show liveness probe failures after restart.

CS-Ops: customer alpha-app is paused, but telemetry-q still has ~30% traffic failing (we queued their webhooks). informing customers via status page.

Jamie: performing controlled drain of node gpu-3a-07 to stop restarts. kubectl commands:

```
kubectl drain gpu-3a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl delete pod -l app=runtime,model=rdx-large-v2 -n runtime-prod
```

drain started 10:07 UTC.

Sara: note: autoscaler kept adding pods which made the OOM ripple across more nodes. I disabled autoscale for gpu-pool-3 for now.

Lee: quick workaround implemented in runtime: when prefill token estimate > 28k, stream prefill in chunks with intermediate KV eviction to keep peak memory low. It's a hotpatch; monitoring for regressions. code snippet:

```
if (prefill_tokens > 28000) {
  stream_prefill_chunks(prefill, chunk_size=8000);
  evict_kv_cache(model, preserve_recent=2);
}
```

Rolling to 3 replicas.

Maria: handoff note for ops: we've reduced customer impact from ~60% failing -> ~7% failing for telemetry-q. alpha-app paused. status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2172345678

CS-Ops: CS has emailed alpha-app and telemetry-q with incident summary and that a temporary reject limit is in place pending root cause fix.

Jamie: I'm going to stay on for the next 45m. Once nodes are stabilized we should revert the aggressive gateway rule and re-enable autoscale in a controlled manner. priorities: 1) prevent further OOM-induced restarts 2) reduce customer errors 3) root cause (why so many tokens in production).

Sara: follow-up items created:
- audit incoming prompt sizes for last 48h (ticket IR-1729)
- add hard prefill cap at gateway (product decision)
- improve runtime memory accounting for KV during prefill
- add a knob to stream prefill by default for >N tokens

I'll open PRs.

Lee: found one suspicious commit in model adapter that accidentally disabled token-sanity checks — rolling back for rdx-large-v2 and adding a regression test.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled to Jamie until 11:00 UTC.

Maria: last observed restart count tailing off. final numbers before mitigation: 112 restarts across pool, after mitigations < 5 in last 10m.

Jamie: closing loop: I'll coordinate postmortem with SRE and ML teams. tagging for follow-up: @Sara @Lee @Maria. adding customer impact note to postmortem.

CS-Ops: customers notified, monitoring OK.

Maria: thanks all. leaving this thread to postmortem tracking. :white_check_mark:
